title: Practice-specific continuing education overlays
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 4.03(4)(c) a registrant who oversees or is directly engaged in sterile compounding, or who practices in a pharmacy licensed under M.G.L. c. 112, § 39G or 39I, must complete at least five contact hours per calendar year in sterile compounding. Under 247 CMR 4.03(4)(d) a registrant who oversees or is directly engaged in complex non-sterile compounding, or who practices in a pharmacy licensed under M.G.L. c. 112, § 39H, must complete at least three contact hours per calendar year in complex non-sterile compounding. Under 247 CMR 4.03(4)(e) a registrant who oversees or is engaged in administering vaccines must complete at least one contact hour on immunizations during the two-year renewal cycle.
exam_relevance: Tests overlays that attach to the practice setting or activity and differ in whether they are measured per calendar year or per cycle.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

common_confusions: The compounding overlays are per calendar year while the immunization overlay is per cycle.
The overlays attach to the licensed setting as well as to personal engagement in the activity.
verification_notes: Read in the current official Board of Registration in Pharmacy publication of 247 CMR 4.00 on 2026-08-19 during Batch 3 tranche B3-A authoring under Issue #91. A fresh independent legal and full-bank realism audit is still required before release.
